rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Use sum_S fhat(S) fhat(S triangle U)=1_{U=empty} to derive a nontrivial entropy-weighted inequality. Preserve signs until after the cancellation that is supposed to pay the cost.

deliverables.description: SIGNED_WEIGHTED_IDENTITY.tex: candidate entropy-weighted consequence of f²=1
CANCELLATION_LEDGER.md: the exact signed step that pays the target debt

acceptance_criteria: Start from all signed convolution identities and retain the phase signs through the decisive cancellation.
Specify the entropy weight and any absolute-convergence/finite-sum manipulation; Parseval or triangle inequality alone must not silently replace the needed signed conclusion.
Locate the consequence absent from the fixed-order non-Boolean controls and quantify the paid term on an actual Boolean class.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new signed inequality paying a named residual term, or a sharply scoped failure of that inequality.

assignments.target_statement: Given a candidate spectral probability law, determine whether signs can produce a Boolean inverse Walsh transform. Produce exact impossibility certificates or actual truth tables, never a merely normalized vector.

deliverables.description: BOOLEAN_REALIZABILITY.json: law, phase signs, exact inverse, or impossibility certificate
REALIZABILITY_METHOD.md: completeness domain and algebraic number handling

acceptance_criteria: An accepted realization has inverse Walsh values exactly ±1, not merely norm one or values numerically close to signs.
An impossibility claim specifies the complete finite phase domain or a proved algebraic obstruction; a failed heuristic search is labelled inconclusive.
Provide the common realizability interface reused by uniform coding, correlated auxiliaries, and the separate biased-normalization referee.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete actual realization or exact impossibility certificate for one live candidate law.

assignments.target_statement: Import the already proved fixed-order signed-convolution and atom-cap-prefix no-go families. State the exact complete derivative, granularity, or convolution hierarchy being used and seek a genuinely additional consequence of full Booleanity that those controls do not satisfy. Merely increasing a fixed prefix, retaining dyadic coefficients, or imposing small norm/square defects is already ruled out.

deliverables.description: NEW_FULL_BOOLEANITY_CONSEQUENCE.md: precise distinction from rejected prefixes

acceptance_criteria: Import the fixed signed-convolution-order no-go and the fixed atom-cap-prefix cyclic-law no-go as rejected baselines.
State the exact hierarchy being used; increasing a fixed truncation order, dyadic coefficients, or small square defect does not constitute a new admission condition.
Prove a genuinely additional consequence of full Booleanity that fails on the relevant controls and show where it could supply the missing high-degree or conditional payment.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new full-Booleanity restriction with an explicit role in one unpaid term is required to renew.

assignments.target_statement: Extend the recovered marginal phase-energy result for actual Boolean signs on disjoint uniform physical cubes X,Y, with integer X-degree bound d≥1, while retaining the full conditional spectral entropy H(S_Y|S_X). Seek a proved stable restricted condition not admitting arbitrary tensor factors. Correlations among spectral auxiliary coordinates are allowed; arbitrary correlated physical input laws are outside the baseline.

deliverables.description: CONDITIONAL_PHASE_THEOREM.tex: explicit stable hypothesis and entropy payment
PHASE_SCOPE.md: physical law, degree, marginal, and conditional terms

acceptance_criteria: Use actual Boolean f on disjoint uniform physical cubes X,Y with integer X-degree d≥1; correlated spectral Y coordinates do not authorize correlated physical inputs.
Retain H(S_Y|S_X) after using H(p_X)≤(2/ln2)I_Y+2(d−1); the marginal estimate cannot be spent twice.
Test the fixed cyclic-marginal arbitrary-tensor embedding, and prove that any purportedly weaker structural condition excludes it without assuming the desired FEI conclusion.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete restricted conditional theorem with proved admission/stability, or a hardness-preserving embedding refuting its claimed simplification.

assignments.target_statement: Test proposed weighted convolution payments on actual Boolean functions with severe cancellation. Separate an invalid triangle inequality or lost sign from a genuine obstruction to the target statement.

deliverables.description: SIGNED_PAYMENT_TESTS.json: candidate, Boolean witnesses, and sign-sensitive quantities
CANCELLATION_FAILURE.tex: smallest failed inequality or surviving scope

acceptance_criteria: Compute the signed convolution before squaring or applying absolute values and retain the exact term where the proposed proof discards cancellation.
Use actual Boolean witnesses for theorem refutations; a non-Boolean relaxation failure is recorded separately as a missing-hypothesis diagnostic.
Certify the violation of the precise weighted inequality and avoid treating a bad proof step as proof that the theorem itself is false.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A candidate-specific signed counterexample or a completed finite certificate with honest bounds on its scope.
